original_goal:
[Module: Payments | TC-008 | Type: Negative | Priority: High]
Title: Payee account number and confirmation do not match

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/bill-pay
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "account_number_A": "ELC123456789",
  "account_number_B": "GAS987654321"
}

Preconditions:
  All other required fields are filled with valid values (payee name/address/phone present).

Steps to Execute:
  1. Enter 'ELC123456789' in Payee Account Number.
  2. Enter 'GAS987654321' in Confirm Account Number.
  3. Click Pay.

Expected Result:
  Inline error "Account numbers do not match" is shown; form does not submit; no payment is created.

Notes from prior verification:
  Used two different seeded payee account numbers to force mismatch (Electric Company vs Gas Utility). Inline validation message is runtime and cannot be confirmed from static DOM.
expected_outcome: Inline error "Account numbers do not match" is shown; form does not submit; no payment is created.
